tools.name: search
tools.description: Search upcoming academic conferences, workshops and calls for papers by words in the title, organizer, location or topic. Returns at most 10 events with their ResearchCal page and official source URL.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Get the public facts of one event by its id from search: dates, location, public deadlines, official and source URLs, and the public calendar feeds that contain it.

tools.name: list_upcoming_deadlines
tools.description: List the upcoming public deadlines (open and announced) in date order, with their type. open_call is true only for open submission and application calls; registration and decision dates are listed with their type and are never open calls. Set open_calls_only to list open calls only. Filter by resear

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List the public ResearchCal calendar feeds (ICS) with their subscribe URLs, optionally for one research field.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
